nar.text: The morning was cloudy, cool and windy with occasional sunshine.
The cars start individually from 7:00 AM in race-number order, three minutes apart because of the dust.
The previous year's winner Costantini drove in 1h27m01s at 74.408 km/h average speed, which placed him 42 seconds ahead of his teammate Minoia.
Materassi's Itala is third, 2½ minutes back, with Wagner's Peugeot two seconds behind; Divo and Goux are over three minutes down.
Masetti's Delage overturns at kilometre 27 before Caltavuturo; the famous driver is killed.
Boillot's car hit a dog, which damaged the Peugeot's sump and ended his race.
Costantini still leads Minoia; Goux moves up from seventh to fourth, Divo is fifth.
Thomas (Delage) stopped with a defect after passing through Polizzi.
At the end of lap three, Costantini had raised his average speed to 74.014 km/h and was over seven minutes ahead of Minoia.
Materassi passes Divo and Goux for third; Goux is fourth ahead of Wagner and Divo.
Divo and Benoist retire at the pits in mourning for their teammate.
Costantini still leads after a pit stop, over four minutes ahead of Minoia and 10½ minutes ahead of Goux.
Costantini wins in a record 7h20m45s at 73.511 km/h, with the fastest lap of the race on the last lap: 1h26m.
Minoia and Goux follow; Alfieri Maserati wins the 1500 category in his first car despite carburation trouble.
